records.symptom: Pressure will not build. The gauge tops out around 8MPa
records.cause: Low hydraulic oil. Level below the lower line on the oil gauge. Slight leak from the cylinder rod packing
records.action: Topped up ISO VG46 hydraulic oil to the upper line. Ordered a rod packing replacement

records.symptom: The slide judders and jolts on the way down
records.cause: Air in the cylinder (not bled after topping up the oil)
records.action: Bled air from the bleed plug. Checked with ten inching strokes

records.symptom: Pressure will not build. The pump rattles
records.cause: Cavitation from a clogged suction strainer
records.action: Removed the suction strainer and cleaned it in cleaning oil. Filtered the oil through a filter unit

records.symptom: Stopped on an oil temperature fault above 60°C
records.cause: The oil cooler's cooling water inlet valve was left half closed
records.action: Opened the cooling water valve fully. Confirmed the specified flow on the flow meter

records.symptom: Pressure does not build when pressing
records.cause: Low hydraulic oil. Seepage from a high-pressure hose joint
records.action: Retightened the hose joint and topped up the oil. Confirmed no leak at the next morning's check

records.symptom: The photoelectric safety device trips and stops the slide
records.cause: Oil mist on the emitter and receiver lenses
records.action: Cleaned the lenses and aligned the beam. Confirmed the stop with a blocking test

records.symptom: Pressure will not build. Stops at 12MPa with a high whine near the pump
records.cause: Debris caught in the relief valve poppet
records.action: Took the relief valve apart and cleaned it. Rechecked the 21.0 MPa setting on the gauge and recorded it on form AP-F21

records.symptom: The slide overruns top dead centre
records.cause: Loose dog on the top dead centre limit switch
records.action: Adjusted and tightened the dog. Confirmed the stop position by inching and a single stroke
